decisions.topic: the p_n construction for the E8B G10 collapse diagnostic
decisions.user_wording: p_n is softmax over length-normalised R1 scores. Treat it only as an E8B-specific pseudo-probability for collapse diagnostics. Do not compare its entropy numerically with E8A entropy. Keep the top-1-share and intervention limbs unchanged.
operational_meaning: p_n is the softmax over the 100 answers of the fp32 length-normalised R1 candidate scores whose argmax is the recorded prediction
the resulting mean prediction entropy is an E8B-specific PSEUDO-PROBABILITY diagnostic, not a calibrated posterior
its numeric value must never be compared with an E8A prediction entropy, in either direction, because the E8A quantity is a softmax over classifier logits on a different scale
every disclosure of an E8B G10 entropy must carry that non-comparability statement
the maximum-class-share limb and the intervention limbs are unchanged

decisions.user_wording: Preserve the full pair-matched B2/B3 design and both 40k and 250k scales. No automatic 250k-only fallback or arm removal is authorised.
operational_meaning: B3 is inseparable from B2 at every scale and seed that either occupies
both train_40k and train_250k remain in the matrix
no code path may drop a 40k arm, reduce seeds, or switch to a 250k-only matrix
if a hard gate fires, execution stops and returns to the user with pair-preserving alternatives

decisions.user_wording: Clarify U3: expected epochs 15/22 are the governing remaining-program projection. The 100-epoch projection remains a mandatory reported stress scenario, but does not halt by itself. The 8-hour per-run, 35-hour per-identity, 80%-reserved-memory, storage, provenance, determinism and G14 gates remain hard halts.
operational_meaning: the governing remaining-program projection uses the expected epoch basis, 15 epochs at train_40k and 22 at train_250k
the governing remaining-core projection is gated against the 180 GPU-hour core ceiling and halts if it exceeds it
the 100-epoch projection is computed and reported on every run as a mandatory stress scenario and is explicitly NON-HALTING on its own
the previous rule under which a 100-epoch worst case above min(180, 3 x expected) halted no longer governs; that comparison is still reported as the stress-scenario verdict

HARD HALTS, unchanged: 8-hour per-run operational wall with a recorded failure status; 35-hour per-model-identity aggregate; peak RESERVED memory above 80 per cent of the device total; storage; provenance; determinism; the binding 64-example G14
